response.query: Which in vitro ADME/Tox screens and interaction assays will be run prior to in vivo scaling (e.g., CYP inhibition, hERG, hepatocyte cytotoxicity, anticoagulant/antidiabetic drug interactions)?
response.answer: Prior to in vivo scaling, CYP inhibition, hERG, hepatocyte cytotoxicity, and anticoagulant/antidiabetic drug interaction assays are typically run. These screens assess potential drug interactions and toxicities.
